_comment: The API's eligibility reasons per strategy (planning/selector.py) and its finding messages (planning/preflight.py) for each finding case - `others` are the plan's other selected VMs, `source_kind` the source provider's kind (openstack when not given), `holds_volumes` whether the migration holds the destination volumes an earlier attempt created (false when not given): test_selector.py and test_preflight.py run them against the API, mockData.test.ts against the dashboard's mock, which words them as the API does (SDD §9.2, §9.3, §16, review RV20-08). source/destination give a provider's capabilities and whether it has a conversion host, as provider_caps reads them. A network or GPU case gives `destination` - its label, kind, networks (id, name, mtu, project_id, own, shared, external), subnets, the token's roles and its policy profile, as the check reports them - and the plan its mappings, prestage_resources and nic_overrides (SDD §6.6, §7.3 step 0, §9.3, §21.5).

finding_cases.why: two NICs on network names that two other projects each use, none in the credential's own

expected.MAP_NETWORK_AMBIGUOUS: The cutover cannot tell these networks of DC3 Jakarta apart: fa:16:3e:00:00:01 (app-net): 2 networks of other projects are named 'app-net' (tenant-a, tenant-b), none of the credential's project; fa:16:3e:00:00:02 (web-net): 2 networks of other projects are named 'web-net' (tenant-c, tenant-d), none of the credential's project.

finding_cases.why: another project's private network, and a shared one the token's roles may not choose an address on

expected.NET_PORT_NOT_PERMITTED: The credential of DC3 Jakarta may not put these NICs on their network: fa:16:3e:00:00:01 on 'priv-net' (project tenant-p): it is neither shared with the credential's project nor external; fa:16:3e:00:00:02 on 'shared-net' (project tenant-s): Neutron's secure-RBAC defaults let only the admin or service role, or that project, choose a port's address or MAC there, and the credential's token has neither.

finding_cases.why: a shared network of another project when the destination's policy profile is unknown

expected.NET_PORT_NOT_PERMITTED: The credential of DC3 Jakarta may not put these NICs on their network: fa:16:3e:00:00:01 on 'shared-net' (project tenant-s): the policy profile of DC3 Jakarta is unknown, so only the admin role, or that project, may choose a port's address or MAC there, and the credential's token lacks it (check DC3 Jakarta so its series is detected, or declare its policy profile or series).
